records.jp: あ、日菜子
更紗。ケガの調子はどう？
あまりよくないの？
ちょっと、場所を変えない？
records.en_original: Could we go somewhere else to talk?
records.en_auxiliary: Could we go somewhere else to talk?
records.en: Could we go somewhere else to talk?

records.jp: いいよ。じゃあまた屋上でいいかな？
records.en_original: Sure. Want to go to the rooftop like always?
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. Want to go to the rooftop?
records.en: Sure. Want to go to the rooftop like always?

records.jp: ええ……
あ、ヒナちゃん、さらちん
また練習？
ううん。ちょっと話したいことがあったの
records.en_original: No, we just needed to talk about something.
records.en_auxiliary: No, we just needed to talk about something.
records.en: No, we just needed to talk about something.

records.jp: 私もケガしちゃってね……
records.en_original: I ended up getting hurt, too...
records.en_auxiliary: I ended up getting hurt, too.
records.en: I ended up getting hurt, too...

records.jp: だ、大丈夫なの！？
ええ。もう治ったわ……
ホントに！？
この間ね、試しに軽く踊ってみたの。<CR>もう痛みはほとんどなくて、これなら大丈夫だと思った
records.en_original: I tried dancing a little earlier. There's pretty much no pain, so I think I'll be okay now.
records.en_auxiliary: I tried dancing a little earlier. There's pretty much no pain, so I think I'll be okay now.
records.en: The other day, I tried dancing lightly as a test.<CR>There was almost no pain, so I thought I'd be fine.

records.jp: 念のため病院で診てもらって、<CR>もう大丈夫だって言われたわ
records.en_original: Just in case, though, I had it checked out at the hospital, and they said it's fine, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Just in case, though, I had it checked out at the hospital, and they said it's fine, too.
records.en: I had the hospital check it just in case,<CR>and they said I'm fine now.

records.jp: ならよかったじゃない
でもダメなの！どうしても、足をかばっちゃって、<CR>前みたいな動きができなくって……
records.en_original: But it's still no good! I can't move like before since I'm trying not strain my leg...
records.en_auxiliary: But it's still no good! I can't move like before because I'm worried about straining my leg.
records.en: But it's no good! I can't help favoring my leg,<CR>and I can't move like I did before...

records.jp: もしまた踊れなくなったら……
records.en: What if I become unable to dance again...

records.jp: 更紗……。もう治ったんでしょ？<CR>だったらまた練習するしかないよ
records.en_original: Sarasa... You said it's healed, right? Then you just have to start practicing again.
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa, you said it's healed, right? Then you just have to start practicing again.
records.en: Sarasa... It's healed, right?<CR>Then all you can do is start practicing again.

records.jp: けど、もしまた怪我をしたら……。<CR>今度こそ私は、怖くてもう踊れなくなってしまう
records.en_original: But if I got hurt again... I'd be too afraid to ever dance again.
records.en_auxiliary: But if I got hurt again... I'd be too afraid to really let myself go when I dance. I don't know if I could dance.
records.en: But if I get injured again...<CR>This time I'd be so afraid I might never be able to dance again.

records.jp: そうしたら……私は……もうトゥシューズを履けない……
records.en_original: If that happened... I wouldn't even be able to put on my pointe shoes...
records.en_auxiliary: If that happened... I wouldn't even be able to lace up my pointe shoes.
records.en: If that happened... I wouldn't even be able to put on my pointe shoes...

records.jp: 日菜子もわかるでしょ？<CR>バレエを失ったら私は……どうすれば……
records.en_original: If I lost ballet...what else would I have? You understand, right, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: If I lost ballet... what else would I have? You understand, right, Hinako?
records.en: You understand, don't you, Hinako?<CR>If I lost ballet... what would I do...

records.jp: ……わからないよ
え？
わかんないよ！　意味わかんない！
records.en_original: I don't get it! I have no idea what you're talking about!
records.en_auxiliary: I don't get it! I have no idea what you're talking about!
records.en: I don't get it! I have no idea what you're talking about!

records.jp: 踊れるんでしょ？　怪我が治ったんでしょ？<CR>だったら踊ればいいじゃない
records.en_original: You can dance, right? Your injury got better, right? Then you should just dance!
records.en_auxiliary: You can dance, right? Your injury got better, right? Then you should just dance!
records.en: You can dance, right? Your injury is healed, right?<CR>Then you should just dance.

records.jp: 日菜子……
私はもう踊れないの。<CR>どんなに頑張っても踊れないの
records.en_original: I can't dance anymore! No matter how hard I try, I can't dance.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't dance anymore! No matter how hard I try, I can't dance.
records.en: I can't dance anymore.<CR>No matter how hard I try, I can't dance.

records.jp: 治る状態の更紗と一緒にしないで！
records.en_original: You got better! Don't act like we're the same!
records.en_auxiliary: You got better! Don't act like we're the same!
records.en: Don't compare yourself to me when your injury can heal!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん！
言い過ぎだよ。さらちんはさらちんで辛いはずだよ。<CR>自分のことは自分しかわからないんだから
records.en_original: You're going too far. Sara is going through a hard time, in her own way. She doesn't know what it's like for you...
records.en_auxiliary: You're going too far. Sara is going through a hard time in her own way. She doesn't know what it's like for you.
records.en: You're going too far. Sara-chin must be hurting in her own way too.<CR>Only she knows what she's going through.

records.jp: ……ごめん
ごめん……なさい……
あああああああああああああああ
更紗！
ヒナちゃん！
わかってる。行こう！
